# ElizaOS Daily Digest: September 1, 2026

Development on September 1, 2026, was dominated by the "Sandboxes V2" epic, focusing on robust cloud infrastructure, secure backup-restore workflows, and hardened inference admission. The team also prioritized system stability through authentication improvements and UI/UX refinements across multiple platform integrations.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Cloud Infrastructure & Sandbox V2**
*   Enhanced system reliability by implementing atomic backup-admission reservations and durable restore streaming ([elizaos/eliza#29782](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29782), [elizaos/eliza#29950](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29950), [elizaos/eliza#29949](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29949)).
*   Deployed quarantined Docker restore capabilities and standardized cleanup workflows ([elizaos/eliza#29928](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29928), [elizaos/eliza#29929](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29929)).
*   Strengthened security by hardening secret transport and optimizing capacity management for replacement attempts ([elizaos/eliza#29925](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29925), [elizaos/eliza#29927](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29927)).

**Authentication & Inference Security**
*   Optimized inference admission by integrating lease management with revocation checks and authoritative pricing ([elizaos/eliza#30096](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30096), [elizaos/eliza#30105](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30105)).
*   Improved session persistence and gated paid routes to ensure secure, authenticated access ([elizaos/eliza#29600](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29600), [elizaos/eliza#30267](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30267)).
*   Enforced strict identity verification for X (Twitter) and Telegram integrations ([elizaos/eliza#29595](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29595), [elizaos/eliza#29767](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29767)).

**UI/UX & Plugin Refinements**
*   Resolved responsive layout regressions in the calendar plugin to ensure consistent viewport rendering ([elizaos/eliza#30251](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30251), [elizaos/eliza#30232](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30232), [elizaos/eliza#30234](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30234)).
*   Refined iMessage transport reporting and canonical date handling for all-day events ([elizaos/eliza#30248](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30248), [elizaos/eliza#30240](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30240)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress

**New Pull Requests (elizaos/eliza)**
*   **Infrastructure:** [#30272](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30272) (Container polling), [#30270](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30270) (Reconnect ladder fencing).
*   **Authentication/Security:** [#30266](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30266) (Late auth hydration), [#30257](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30257) (Steward session serialization), [#30256](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30256) (Paid legacy proxy routes), [#30243](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30243) (SSO bridge custody).
*   **Integrations/Plugins:** [#30262](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30262) (Telegram gateway), [#30260](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30260), [#30259](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30259), [#30258](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30258) (Discord string truncation), [#30255](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30255) (WhatsApp chatId truncation), [#30254](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30254) (Google grants), [#30245](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30245), [#30244](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30244) (OpenAI telemetry).
*   **Dependencies:** [#30268](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30268) (Bump nltk).
